# google_resource_manager_boundary

A Boundary is a collection of projects defined by filtering criteria on an
organization or a folder. Descendant projects are dynamically included in the
Boundary based on the configured resource filter.

Membership is recomputed asynchronously, so the projects inside a Boundary
are not necessarily settled by the time the apply returns.


To get more information about Boundary, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/resource-manager/reference/rest/v3/organizations.boundaries)
* How-to Guides
    * [Official Documentation](https://cloud.google.com/resource-manager/docs/boundaries)


## Example Usage - Resource Manager Boundary Basic


```hcl
resource "google_folder" "folder" {
  display_name        = "bnd-fldr"
  parent              = "organizations/123456789"
  deletion_protection = false
}

resource "google_folder_iam_member" "folder_editor" {
  folder = google_folder.folder.folder_id
  role   = "roles/resourcemanager.editor"
  member = "serviceAccount:my@service-account.com"
}

resource "time_sleep" "wait_60_seconds" {
  create_duration = "60s"
  depends_on      = [google_folder_iam_member.folder_editor]
}

resource "google_tags_tag_key" "boundary" {
  parent      = "organizations/123456789"
  short_name  = "bndkey"
  description = "Partitioning tag key used by boundaries under this folder."
}

resource "google_tags_tag_value" "boundary" {
  parent      = google_tags_tag_key.boundary.id
  short_name  = "bndval"
  description = "Tag value selecting the projects inside the boundary."
}

resource "google_tags_tag_value" "boundary_updated" {
  parent      = google_tags_tag_key.boundary.id
  short_name  = "bndval-updated"
  description = "Updated tag value selecting the projects inside the boundary."
}

# A BoundaryConfig naming the partitioning tag key must exist on the parent
# before any Boundary can be created under it.
resource "google_resource_manager_boundary_config" "boundary" {
  parent     = google_folder.folder.name
  tag_key    = google_tags_tag_key.boundary.namespaced_name
  depends_on = [time_sleep.wait_60_seconds]
}

resource "google_resource_manager_boundary" "boundary" {
  parent       = google_folder.folder.name
  boundary_id  = "bnd"
  display_name = "Example boundary"

  resource_filter {
    tag_filter {
      tag_key   = google_resource_manager_boundary_config.boundary.tag_key
      tag_value = google_tags_tag_value.boundary.short_name
    }
  }

  depends_on = [google_resource_manager_boundary_config.boundary]
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `parent` -
  (Required)
  The parent resource under which the Boundary is created. Must be of the
  form `organizations/{organization_id}` or `folders/{folder_id}`.

* `boundary_id` -
  (Required)
  The user-assigned ID for the Boundary, which becomes the final component
  of the Boundary's resource name. Must be unique within the parent.
  Must be 6 to 30 lowercase ASCII letters, digits, or hyphens, must start
  with a letter, and may not end with a hyphen.


* `display_name` -
  (Optional)
  Human-readable display name of the Boundary. When present it must be
  between 4 and 30 characters. Allowed characters are lowercase and
  uppercase letters, numbers, hyphen, single-quote, double-quote, space,
  and exclamation point.

* `resource_filter` -
  (Optional)
  The filter defining the criteria for descendant projects to be included
  in the Boundary.
  `tag_value` is the only part of the filter that can be changed after
  creation, and it cannot be cleared.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_resource_filter).

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


<a name="nested_resource_filter"></a>The `resource_filter` block supports:

* `tag_filter` -
  (Required)
  A tag based filter. A project must match it to be included in the
  Boundary.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_resource_filter_tag_filter).


<a name="nested_resource_filter_tag_filter"></a>The `tag_filter` block supports:

* `tag_key` -
  (Required)
  The namespaced name of the tag key, in the form
  `{parent_id}/{tag_key_short_name}`, for example `123456789012/env`.

* `tag_value` -
  (Required)
  The allowed short name of the tag value, for example `production`.
  A project matches this tag filter if its effective tag value for
  the given `tagKey` matches this value.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `{{parent}}/boundaries/{{boundary_id}}`

* `name` -
  The unique resource name of the Boundary, in the form
  `organizations/{organization_id}/boundaries/{boundary_id}` or
  `folders/{folder_id}/boundaries/{boundary_id}`.

* `management_project` -
  The Management Project associated with this Boundary, in the form
  `projects/{project_number}`. This is populated by the service when the
  Boundary is associated with a CapabilityConfig; it cannot be set directly
  on the Boundary. To choose a management project, set it on the
  `google_resource_manager_capability_config` resource instead.

* `state` -
  The lifecycle state of the Boundary. Possible values are `CREATING` and
  `ACTIVE`.

* `etag` -
  A checksum computed by the server based on the value of other fields. May
  be sent on update requests to ensure the client has an up-to-date value
  before proceeding.

* `create_time` -
  The creation time of the Boundary.

* `update_time` -
  The most recent time this Boundary was modified.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


Boundary can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `{{parent}}/boundaries/{{boundary_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import Boundary using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    parent = "<-required value->"
    boundaryId = "<-required value->"
  }
  to = google_resource_manager_boundary.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import Boundary using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "{{parent}}/boundaries/{{boundary_id}}"
  to = google_resource_manager_boundary.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), Boundary can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_resource_manager_boundary.default {{parent}}/boundaries/{{boundary_id}}
```
